# WWF Superstars Enhanced 2.1

The European, Canadian, Japanese and US revisions 4, 6 and 7 share `jtwwfss_llapi20.rbf`. Update All replaces the existing core and retains the six game entries.

Select **Show Credits on Pause** to show credits when pausing, including when opening the MiSTer menu pauses the game. The default is Off. LLAPI 2P uses driver 1.0.0 with Immediate Repoll enabled.

For SNAC turbo, hold the action you want to repeat, then press and release Start three times. Repeat the gesture to restore manual input for that action. Releasing the action stops the pulses. The normal controls are A for Punch, B for Kick and X for 1P/2P vs CPU. With a DB15 pad, Start and C together open the menu. To program C, hold C first, then tap Start three times.

The six SNAC interface modes, individual P1/P2 actions, releases, USB and LLAPI input, and the pause credits selector passed simulation. Physical testing of this WWF build is pending.

Quartus Prime Lite 20.1.1 Build 720 accepted seed 1 with setup margin +0.439 ns and hold margin +0.243 ns. The compiled RBF is 3,030,024 bytes and its SHA-256 is `ab34eda51621089560d905cbcefd4ce15f84f0010ad9ab427766df70e9203669`.
